about: SyncPlanner: this device's entries ("local"), another device's ("peer") and what the two last agreed on ("base") turn into operations on this vault and conflicts to show. Entries are {key, path, text, hash}: hash is SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the text's UTF-8 bytes. "deleted" lists versions some device recorded deleting (key, hash). "validateTasks": a merged task file must still parse as a task (else both versions are kept whole). Ops come in the order they must be applied: moves, deletes (to the trash), writes (expected: the hash the file must still have, null = must not exist), settings, the Now order, activity. "nextBase": what the two devices agree on after a sync (computed from the vault as it is after applying the plan). Generated by the C# core (SyncFixtureTests).
